title: Visible Shield Break Sound
description: Makes the shield break sound fully visible for better PvP reaction.
body:
# Visible Shield Break Sound
This pack makes the shield break sound fully visible by adding a clear visual effect whenever a shield gets broken. It helps players instantly notice shield breaks during intense PvP fights, making reactions faster and combat feel smoother. Perfect for PvP players who want better awareness, cleaner feedback, and a more satisfying fighting experience
